name: clinical_full
description: Vollständiges klinisches Datenpaket: alle Domänen inklusive Zeitreihen
description_en: Full clinical data package: all domains including time series

queries.daily_summary: SELECT * FROM daily_context WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.sleep_sessions: SELECT * FROM sleep WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.training_sessions: SELECT * FROM training WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts_start
queries.orthostatic_tests: SELECT * FROM orthostatic_test WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.fitness_tests: SELECT * FROM polar_fitness WHERE person = :person AND date(datetime) BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY datetime
queries.migraine: SELECT * FROM migraine_live WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.ecg_sessions: SELECT * FROM ecg_sessions WHERE person = :person AND date(datetime) BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY datetime
queries.blood_pressure: SELECT * FROM blood_pressure WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.blood_glucose: SELECT * FROM blood_glucose WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.body_composition: SELECT * FROM body_composition WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.symptoms: SELECT * FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.reproductive_health: SELECT * FROM reproductive_health WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.medications: SELECT * FROM medications WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.lab_results: SELECT * FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.assessments: SELECT * FROM assessments WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.nutrition_daily: SELECT * FROM nutrition_daily WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.clinical_findings: SELECT * FROM clinical_findings WHERE finding_date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY finding_date
queries.pem_correlation: SELECT * FROM pem_correlation WHERE date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.arrhythmia_episodes: SELECT * FROM arrhythmie_episoden WHERE date(episode_start) BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY episode_start
queries.daily_stress: SELECT * FROM daily_stress WHERE date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.health_canonical: SELECT * FROM health_canonical WHERE date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, metric
